changelog:
Initial release of video-transcript-txt.

- Transcribes one or more local videos into cleaned TXT files, with precise segment start/end timestamps.
- Supports batch processing with parallelism limits (default max 2, up to 3 for short/easy cases).
- Outputs: per-video TXT in the same directory; also summarizes total video duration and actual total processing time for multi-video jobs.
- Strict handling: will not overwrite without explicit user approval, never deletes or moves original videos, cleans all temp/intermediate files.
- Rejects incomplete downloads and enforces dependency checks (`uv`, `ffmpeg`, `ffprobe`).
- Supports language selection; defaults to Chinese if not specified.
- Robust error/stop handling to prevent faulty outputs and ensure accurate reporting.
